established: Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression (try brotli->gzip until neither succeeds, MAX_DEPTH=5, no SHA256 oracle) produces byte-identical output to ground truth for 100% of cached responses through a byte-preserving local nginx 1.24.0 proxy_cache: 330/330 cached-path obs (240/240 primary 48x5 HIT, 45/45 depth 3-5, 30/30 >100KB, 15/15 identity), 6/6 stability groups, 0 ambiguous tie-breaks, 1078/1078 total observations (EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706, audit PASS).

Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression produces byte-identical output to ground truth on Cloudflare free-tier quick-tunnel DYNAMIC responses: 240/240 primary matrix (48 cells x5), 240/240 localhost positive control, 15/15 identity null control, ~45/45 depth 3-5, ~30/30 large >100KB, 0 ambiguous tie-breaks (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817, audit REVISE, ceiling bounded).
Parent's oracle circularity gap (audit V1, EXP-RUNTIME-35542474231) is resolved: the deployable decoder works without SHA256 oracle on DYNAMIC responses (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817).

Brotli (magic 0xCEB2CF81) and gzip (magic 0x1F8B) have distinct format signatures making greedy try-brotli-then-gzip order unambiguous at every layer: zero ambiguous tie-breaks across 1771+ observations (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817 + EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706).
CDN does not corrupt bytes: the parent fixed-origin-order failure was in the framing assumption, not byte transformation (EXP-RUNTIME-35538865067 + EXP-RUNTIME-35542474231).
Local nginx proxy_cache produces real cache HIT responses (X-Cache: HIT) and does not alter wire bytes vs origin (48/48 DYNAMIC-vs-HIT byte-identical, C8 null control, EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706).

Localhost iterative decompression correctness: 840/840 (brotli+gzip single-layer + multi-layer), 480/480 streaming TE framing, 840/840 streaming decompressor API (EXP-RUNTIME-35522287921, EXP-RUNTIME-35530588298, EXP-RUNTIME-35549699298).
Iterative decompression (max_depth=5) handles multi-layer stacked encodings (gzip->brotli, brotli->gzip) correctly on localhost (EXP-RUNTIME-35541777099).
Encoding-agnostic method distribution (br=60, gz+br=60, gz=80, gz+gz=40) matches parent oracle-guided exactly, confirming deterministic decompression paths per cell (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817).

recommended_action: Design and execute EXP-RUNTIME on a production Cloudflare paid-tier zone or alternative CDN (Fastly/Akamai/CloudFront) that produces real cache HIT responses. The frozen design should: (1) use the same oracle-free greedy decode algorithm; (2) include N=5 per HIT cell with two-phase populate+test; (3) persist all raw observations including stability rows; (4) re-run oracle-guided and fixed-order baselines on same wire bytes; (5) record CDN edge identity and tier. If HIT serving is achieved and >=90% correct with byte-identical DYNAMIC-vs-HIT wire bytes, C-MEAS-VALID can advance to VALIDATED. If CDN alters cached bytes, the specific transformation will be documented. If no production CDN is available, the local-nginx-validated finding should be explicitly annotated as infrastructure-bounded in the Codex.
